info.name: ShabbosRent API Collection
info.description: Complete API documentation and Postman collection for ShabbosRent Backend, covering all 21 modules including Auth, Users, Apartments, Calendar, Availability, Payments, Swaps, Calls, Inquiries, Report Rented, Ambassador Program, News, Advertisements, and Real-Time Alerts.

item.name: 1. Authentication
item.description: User signup, login, OTP verification, password recovery, and refresh token management.

item.name: 2. User Management
item.description: User profile retrieval, updates, and admin user list/role/status controls.

item.name: 3. Apartments
item.description: Create, view, filter, update, and manage apartments, amenities, and owner listings.

item.name: Get Single Apartment by ID / PropertyId
Admin: Update Apartment Status (Publish / Unpublish / Block)
4. Weekend Calendar
item.description: Manage Shabbat weekend calendar dates and holiday entries across Israel.

item.name: 5. Apartment Availability
item.description: Manage Shabbat weekend availability, custom pricing per date, and blocked slots.

item.name: 6. Calls & WhatsApp (Contact Landlord)
item.description: Twilio masked click-to-call bridging, WhatsApp contact click logging, TwiML generation, and webhooks.

item.name: Initiate Masked Voice Call (Hotline or Landlord)
Admin: Get All Platform Call Logs
7. Payments & Nedarim Integration
item.description: Intent creation, Nedarim iframe verification, listing fees, report rented fees, swap fees, and admin transaction logs.

item.name: 8. Report Rented
item.description: Hosts reporting an apartment as rented for a specific weekend date and paying the ₪50 fee.

item.name: 9. Apartment Swaps
item.description: Apartment swap preferences, mutual swap requests, approvals, and swap history.

body.raw:
{
  "apartmentId": "APARTMENT_ID_HERE",
  "isEnabled": true,
  "preferredCities": [
    "Jerusalem",
    "Bnei Brak",
    "Tsfat"
  ],
  "minRooms": 3,
  "maxGuests": 8,
  "note": "Looking to swap for Shabbat Chanukah or Purim."
}

item.name: Get Swap Preference by Apartment ID
10. Reviews & Ratings
item.description: Guest reviews, star ratings, and admin moderation (approval/rejection).

item.name: Admin: Get All Reviews for Moderation
11. Wishlist
item.description: Save and manage favorite apartments in personal wishlist.

item.name: 12. Offers (Price Negotiation)
item.description: Guest price offers on specific Shabbat dates and host counter-offers / approvals.

item.name: 13. Interested Requests
item.description: General guest inquiries expressing interest in an apartment.

item.name: Get Interested Requests for My Apartment
14. Notify Requests (Waitlist)
item.description: Guests requesting notifications when an occupied apartment or date becomes free.

item.name: 15. Contact Us
item.description: Public contact form submissions and admin response management.

item.name: 16. Ambassador Program
item.description: Full ambassador lifecycle: registration, referral links, Model A/B selection, manual claims, payout requests, sub-ambassador tiers, and admin controls.

item.name: Select Commission Model (Model A or Model B)
Manual Claim Apartment by Phone / Email
Admin: Get All Ambassador Applications & Records
17. Community News & Updates
item.description: Community news articles, Shabbat guides, hotline announcements, and CMS publication controls.
